summary_en: This phase 2 study tests outpatient use of teclistamab or talquetamab, both antibody drugs, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Teclistamab or talquetamab is given under the skin, with step-up doses followed by repeat dosing in 28-day cycles, and tocilizumab and oral dexamethasone are given as pretreatment. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la administración ambulatoria de teclistamab o talquetamab, dos fármacos de tipo anticuerpo, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. Teclistamab o talquetamab se administra debajo de la piel, con dosis de inicio escalonadas seguidas de dosis repetidas en ciclos de 28 días, y tocilizumab y dexametasona oral se dan como medicamentos previos. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with multiple myeloma diagnosed by IMWG criteria.

not_for: Rapidly progressing disease per the investigator.
Plasma cell leukemia, Waldenström's macroglobulinemia, POEMS syndrome, or primary amyloid light-chain amyloidosis.
Known active brain or nervous system involvement, or meningeal involvement of myeloma.
Grade 3 or higher blood side effects or clinically significant non-blood side effects.
Fever or active infection at enrollment, or hepatitis B or active hepatitis C infection.
